page.faq1_q: What level are the stories for?
page.faq1_a: The stories are designed for A1–A2 learners. Listen on their own or read along. Even if you don’t understand everything yet, the text will help you follow the story.
page.faq2_q: What if I miss a day?
page.faq2_a: No problem! Once opened, stories remain available. Listen whenever you like.
page.faq3_q: Can I buy the calendar in December?
page.faq3_a: Sales open before December 1. Doors then open daily from December 1 to 24. Sales availability during Advent will be shown on the site.
page.faq4_q: Who writes and narrates the stories?
page.faq4_a: All stories were created by the CampusFR team for this project and brought to life by Monique, a native French speaker.
page.faq5_q: Can I give the calendar as a gift?
page.faq5_a: Gifting will be available once the gift-delivery flow is ready.
page.faq6_q: How long will I have access?
page.faq6_a: For life! Christmas may end, but your favorite stories will stay with you.
